items.title: AB-3028 CAR-T Cell Therapy Trial for Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: This Phase 1/2 trial is testing AB-3028, a programmable T-cell therapy, in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. CAR-T therapy trains immune cells to attack cancer. The trial is currently recruiting patients to evaluate safety and effectiveness.

items.title: Niraparib Plus Abiraterone Phase 3 Trial for Metastatic Prostate Cancer
items.summary: This Phase 3 trial compares niraparib (a PARP inhibitor) combined with abiraterone and prednisone against standard abiraterone/prednisone alone. The trial evaluates whether adding niraparib improves outcomes in metastatic prostate cancer. It is no longer enrolling but still active.

items.title: Pasritamig With Docetaxel Phase 3 Trial for Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: This Phase 3 trial tests whether pasritamig (a bispecific antibody) combined with docetaxel chemotherapy improves progression-free survival compared to docetaxel alone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. The study is actively recruiting patients.

items.title: Mevrometostat for Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer Phase 1 Trial
items.summary: This Phase 1 study evaluates mevrometostat, an epigenetic drug, alone or with enzalutamide in patients with castration-resistant prostate cancer who have progressed on prior treatment. The trial is recruiting to assess safety and effects of this novel therapeutic approach.

items.title: Pasritamig Phase 3 Trial in Late-Stage Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: This Phase 3 study evaluates pasritamig plus best supportive care versus placebo in late-stage metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients. The primary goal is to determine if pasritamig extends overall survival. The trial is currently recruiting.

items.title: Mevrometostat Plus Enzalutamide Phase 3 Trial for Metastatic Prostate Cancer
items.summary: This Phase 3 trial compares mevrometostat combined with enzalutamide against enzalutamide alone in patients with metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer who have not yet received androgen pathway inhibitors. The study is recruiting patients.

items.title: Cabozantinib and Atezolizumab Phase 2 Trial for Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: This Phase 2 trial tests whether cabozantinib (a targeted therapy) combined with atezolizumab (an immunotherapy) can shrink tumors in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. The combination blocks tumor growth signals and activates the immune system. Currently recruiting.

items.title: Pasritamig Combination Therapy Phase 1 Trial for Metastatic Prostate Cancer
items.summary: This Phase 1 study tests pasritamig combined with other treatments for metastatic prostate cancer. The trial aims to find optimal dosing and assess safety of these combination approaches. Currently recruiting patients.

items.title: Radium-223 Plus M3814 and Avelumab Trial for Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: This Phase 1/2 trial compares radium-223 radiation alone against combinations with M3814 (DNA repair inhibitor) and/or avelumab (immunotherapy) for castration-resistant prostate cancer with bone metastases. The study tests whether combining these treatments improves outcomes. Currently recruiting.

items.title: Mevrometostat Plus Enzalutamide Phase 3 Trial for Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: This Phase 3 study tests whether mevrometostat combined with enzalutamide works better than enzalutamide alone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients who haven't received prior androgen pathway inhibitors. Currently recruiting.

items.title: Sacituzumab Govitecan Phase 2 Trial for Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: This Phase 2 study investigates sacituzumab govitecan (an antibody-drug conjugate) in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients whose disease progressed on newer androgen-blocking drugs like enzalutamide or abiraterone. The trial is no longer recruiting.

items.title: INV-9956 Phase 1/2 Trial for Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: This Phase 1/2 study evaluates INV-9956, a new investigational drug, in adults with advanced metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. The trial assesses safety, how the drug works in the body, and anti-tumor activity. Currently recruiting.

items.title: DIRECT Trial: Shorter Treatment Duration in Oligometastatic Prostate Cancer
items.summary: This Phase 2 randomized trial tests whether adding abiraterone to standard radiation and hormone therapy improves quality of life in oligometastatic prostate cancer (limited metastases). Participants receive treatment for 8-9 months. Currently recruiting.

items.title: Dual BRD4/AKT Inhibitors Overcome Resistance in Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: Researchers developed new drugs that block both BRD4 and AKT proteins to overcome c-MYC-driven resistance in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Lab studies show these dual inhibitors can combat resistance that develops when AKT inhibitors are used alone. Preclinical research stage.

items.title: Machine Learning Model Predicts Survival in Prostate Cancer Bone Metastases
items.source: The aging male : the official journal of the International Society for the Study of the Aging Male
items.summary: Scientists developed an artificial intelligence model that predicts overall survival in non-surgical prostate cancer patients with bone metastases. The model identified Gleason score as the most important survival factor, more important than tumor stage. This tool may help guide treatment decisions.

items.title: New ALDH7A1 Inhibitors for Prostate Cancer Therapy
items.source: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry
items.summary: Researchers discovered new drugs that selectively target ALDH7A1, an enzyme that drives prostate cancer progression. These compounds show selectivity for ALDH7A1 and represent a potential new treatment approach, especially for metastatic castration-resistant disease. Early research stage.

items.title: Meta-Analysis of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors in Metastatic CRPC
items.summary: This analysis of 21 trials with 1,580 metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients found that immune checkpoint inhibitors combined with other treatments showed better survival than immunotherapy alone. Overall results were modest: 63% one-year survival and 41% six-month progression-free survival.

items.title: Bone Health Effects of Enzalutamide With/Without Zoledronic Acid
items.summary: This Phase 2 trial (BonEnza) studied bone health in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer patients receiving androgen deprivation plus enzalutamide with or without zoledronic acid. After 18 months, bone density decreased significantly in both groups, but patients receiving zoledronic acid maintained better bone quality scores.
